schema: pallas_cells/v1: the JAX-family (Pallas-Triton and pure-XLA) rows of the pair-stack / MSA-stack sub-layers and their measured cells. A CELL key is '<jax line>|<cc>|<dtype>|<op>|<family>|N<=<tokens>|<direction>' (jax line = major.minor of the running jax; cc = compute capability; dtype bf16 | f32 = the activations'; op = attn | triattn | trimul | transition | ln | opm | glut; family = the shape word of families[op]; tokens = the smallest measured token count at or above the call's; direction fwd | fwdbwd). Per cell: every arm timed in ONE process on the cell's stack ('<row>' | '<row>:<f32 word>' | '<row>@<setting>'), ms, x_stock = stock ms / arm ms (stock = the program's own XLA ops, row 'xla'), peak_mib (XLA memory analysis of the jitted arm), cls (tol = tolerance class vs the fp32 reference; exact = bitwise the stock op's output; stock / stock_lib = the framework's own ops), 'fast' / 'fast_order' = the arms that beat the stock op fastest first (ending with 'xla'), 'exact' = an arm bitwise the stock op AND >= x1.00, else 'xla' by name, 'big' = the lowest-peak arm at >= x1.00, 'parity' flags a named winner inside x0.97-1.03, 'refused' = arms that did not serve the cell with the refusal word measured, 'unmeasured' = arms closed n/a by rule.
default_rule: select(word=<row>) serves exactly that row with the row's own defaults (what a kit binding that module today already runs, byte for byte: fpf_block == fpf_pallas_serve.tri_attn_block, fpf_trimul == fpf_pallas_serve.trimul_block, pallas_attn == pallas_attn.af2_flash_pallas.make_flash_attention()(...), glut == pallas_glut.glu_transposed_masked, xla == the program's own ops). The measured winners are OPT-IN: a kit reaches them only through a tier word (fast | exact | big, narrowed by prefer=(row, ...)) or by naming the arm ('<row>@<setting>'). A row that cannot serve refuses BY NAME (Refusal.kind / .row / .fallback); nothing substitutes a row silently. MODEL_OPT_LEVERS_OFF words 'pallas' / 'pallas:<row>' switch rows off (refused by name: levers_off).
exact_rule: JAX 'exact' = bitwise vs the XLA stock path, which a fused kernel is only where it reproduces the stock op's own kernel arithmetic (glut vs the tokamax GLU on the 0.10 line; opm_stockbody = the stock body re-stated): named where measured bitwise AND >= x1.00; every other Pallas row is tolerance class (cls 'tol', numerics = max-abs / rel-RMS vs the fp32 reference) and the exact tier's value there is the stock op by name ('xla').

tiers.fast: the cell's 'fast' arm (first of fast_order the running process admits; prefer=(row, ...) narrows the candidates in the kit's order)
tiers.exact: the cell's 'exact' arm: bitwise the stock op AND >= x1.00; 'xla' (the program's own statement) by name everywhere else
tiers.big: fast's order minus arms with a measured memory cost over the stock statement (max(8 MiB, 2 %)): big_rule; the former lowest-peak arm is kept per cell as 'big_lowest_peak'

f32.tf32: f32 activations: tensor-float-32 products (fpf rows: mma tf32; pallas_attn / cd_triatt / rowshared: f32_precision tf32; mlp_transition / opm_two_launch: their tf32 word)
f32.tf32x3: fpf rows only: split-float products (dot-algorithm preset), ~1e-5 class
f32.ieee: full fp32 products (pallas_attn's module default forward AND backward: x10-20 slower than tf32, measured; never a tier word's choice)

fpf_trimul@hi.applies: fpf_trimul bf16: f32 hand-off of the contraction

fpf_trimul@w4.applies: fpf_trimul prologue (w1) / epilogue (w2) num_warps 4 on cc 9.0 (tile table default 8)

cd_trimul@t32w8.applies: cd_trimul forward tiles (prologue t1 / epilogue t3 = 32 rows, 8 warps) for f32 at c_hidden >= 128 on cc 8.x (module default 64 / 4: x0.21-0.31 of the stock statement there)

mlp_transition@bwd_reference.applies: mlp_transition under a gradient (XLA reference backward)

triattn_xla@vjp.applies: triattn_xla: the differentiable row (by word only)
triattn_xla@vjp.evidence: bridge fwdbwd cells (the bridge package's own table)

words.levers_off: MODEL_OPT_LEVERS_OFF words 'pallas' (every non-stock row) and 'pallas:<row>' switch rows off; a switched-off row is refused by name (levers_off) naming its fallback

pallas_attn.numerics: online softmax, fp32 statistics and accumulators; 16-bit inputs at 16-bit products; f32 inputs at the f32 word's products (ieee = full fp32, the module default fwd AND bwd; tf32; bf16)
pallas_attn.head_dims: >=16 power of two (8 is zero-padded to 16 by the face: mandatory, an unpadded 8 gives wrong outputs); 24 / 48 refused by name (head_dim_not_pow2)
settings: pallas_attn@bwd_tf32 (f32 backward products at tf32: the measured fast f32 backward; ieee backward is x2-4 slower than XLA)

cd_triatt.module: opt_core.kernels.pallas_triatt.triatt_attn (make_attention; backward pallas_triatt.attbwd_dkdv: dK/dV key-major + dQ/d-bias partials, no atomics) -- carried by the core beside this package
cd_triatt.numerics: online softmax base-2, fp32 statistics; P and dS rounded to the input dtype before their products (the stock module's rounding points); f32 inputs at f32_precision (default tf32 | ieee); dead rows = the stock clip semantics; S_k < 16 runs the small-S XLA statement
cd_triatt.head_dims: 16..128 power of two (8 zero-padded to 16 by the face); 24 / 48 refused by name
refusals: launch_fails (cc 8.0, f32 fwdbwd at 800 tokens on the 0.6 line: resource exhausted, measured)

rowshared.numerics: pallas_attn's forward arithmetic per row (bitwise per row by construction and measurement); backward = pallas_attn's backward kernels
rowshared.head_dims: >=16 (8 zero-padded to 16 by the face); refuses head_dim_lt_16 itself
settings: rowshared@r2 (rows 2, grouped: the bare row word)

fpf_core.module: opt_core.kernels.fpf_pallas_serve.attention_core (the fused block's flash core alone; layout [B,S,H,D])
refusals: n_not_tile_multiple (the face zero-pads queries and keys to the tile multiple with the padded keys masked: exact)

triattn_xla.module: opt_core.kernels.triattn_xla.triangle_attention (XLA-FFI launcher over pre-compiled sm_90a CUDA / sm_90+sm_80 K2B kernels; its own CELLS.json)
triattn_xla.numerics: the K2B / sm_90a CUDA kernels' (bf16 tensor-core products, fp32 softmax and bias; f32 inputs at TF32 products)
triattn_xla.backward_note: the bare row is forward only (refuses differentiation by name); 'triattn_xla@vjp' = the bridge's differentiable row (vjp='auto': K2B forward cubin with log-sum-exp + a Pallas backward chosen by its own table: pallas_triatt attbwd / pallas_attn flash), reached by word only, the preferred differentiated triangle-attention row where its cells measured it ahead (bridge 'fwdbwd')
refusals: no_backward (bare row: raises under jax.grad / vjp / jvp by name)
needs_jax_ffi (a jax without jax.ffi or a jaxlib FFI version without a launcher build)
its own named refusals (card, dtype, head_dim, batch, a jax whose Pallas backward modules do not import)

xla.module: the program's own XLA statement (the face's reference_* functions: einsum / softmax / LayerNorm / GEMMs at the caller's dtype)

xla_subbatch4.module: the AF2-family stock Attention module at inference (query sub-batches of 4 over the row axis): the engine's own module, timed as an arm; not served by this face

xla_sdpa.module: jax.nn.dot_product_attention(implementation='xla') with bias + key mask folded into one additive tensor

cudnn.backward: differentiated calls WITH a key mask are refused by name (cudnn_shared_bias_grad): measured through this face, cuDNN's VJP drops the shared d(bias) entirely on the jax 0.5 line whenever a key mask is given (d(bias) == 0) and returns gradients 40-57x the reference scale from fully-masked query rows on the jax 0.10 line (cosine 0.16-0.18; the JAX bench's 0.13); unmasked differentiated calls serve (cosine >= 0.9999, d(bias) rel-RMS 3e-3 on both lines; select(key_masked=False)); forward always serves

tokamax.module: tokamax.dot_product_attention(implementation = triton | cudnn | xla) -- the AF3-JAX stock op
refusals: needs_tokamax (not importable on the running stack)

fpf_block.module: opt_core.kernels.fpf_pallas_serve.tri_attn_block (fpf_pallas.triattn_pallas bf16 | fpf_pallas_f32 | fpf_pallas_bias: prologue, flash core, epilogue = 3 launches; pad -> kernel_n)
fpf_block.numerics: bf16: the stock bf16 class (precision std | hi); f32: the precision word is REQUIRED (tf32 | tf32x3 | ieee; per-line unlaunchable words refuse by name)

proj+<core>.module: the face's XLA LayerNorm + projections around a core row (proj+pallas_attn | proj+cd_triatt | proj+fpf_core | proj+cudnn | proj+tokamax | proj+triattn_xla): what an AF2-family kit that swaps only the attention core runs

fpf_trimul.module: opt_core.kernels.fpf_pallas_serve.trimul_block (fpf_pallas.trimul_pallas bf16 | fpf_pallas_f32 | fpf_pallas_bias: prologue kernel -> one XLA batched GEMM -> epilogue kernel; pad -> kernel_n)
fpf_trimul.numerics: bf16 std | hi (f32 hand-off of the contraction); f32: precision word REQUIRED (tf32 | tf32x3 | ieee)
settings: fpf_trimul@w4 (cc 9.0 c128 num_warps 4: the tuned launch cell)

cd_trimul.module: .cd_trimul.trimul_pallas (triangle_multiplication: prologue kernel -> one batched GEMM on zero-padded channel-major planes -> epilogue kernel; custom_vjp backward = two fused cotangent kernels + XLA GEMMs)
cd_trimul.numerics: tanh-form sigmoid, fp32 LayerNorm statistics in registers; bf16 products for bf16, default-precision (TF32-class) products for f32; parameters in the AF2-multimer fused-projection tree form

bridge.rule: op attn families tri_* / tmpl_* and op triattn (triangle attention, forward): where the running jax has jax.ffi and opt_core.kernels.triattn_xla serves (cc, dtype, head_dim), the tier word 'fast' names the bridge row 'triattn_xla' (or 'proj+triattn_xla' at module level) AHEAD of the Pallas arms when its kernels measured ahead of the fused Pallas core on that (line, cc, dtype, head_dim) ('ahead_of_pallas' non-empty); the Pallas block / core rows are the fallback it names. The numbers are the bridge package's own bench (kernels/triattn_xla/CELLS.json), restated per line and card. Differentiated calls (direction fwdbwd, head_dim 32): where a bridge cell carries a 'fwdbwd' block with preferred=true (its differentiable row measured ahead of the stock statement and at or within 3 %% of the best Pallas fwd+bwd row on that (line, cc, dtype)), the tier word 'fast' names the arm 'triattn_xla@vjp' (module level 'proj+triattn_xla@vjp') AHEAD of the Pallas rows, which are the fallback it names; on a line without such a block (the 0.5 line) the Pallas rows serve differentiated calls.
bridge.trimul_native_xla: op trimul, af3 families (bias-free form), cc 9.0 bf16: the row native_xla (opt_core.kernels.trimul_xla: the sealed trimul_native sm_90a kernels through the XLA-FFI launcher) is an arm of the cells where it won the same-process race against the incumbent fast arm by >= 5 %% with disjoint IQR boxes (pair stack c128, buckets N<=800 and N<=1200); the parity cells (N<=400, the c64 template stack) keep their arms and the row stays selectable by word; numbers per size in kernels/trimul_xla/CELLS.json "measured". f32 (fp32-resident z) is a bf16-compute tolerance row, never a candidate of the f32 cells.

refusal_evidence.mlp_transition: its '@bwd_reference' setting (custom_vjp with the f32 XLA reference backward) differentiated in bf16 on the jax 0.6 line: gradients outside the op's class on BOTH cards -- H100 80GB HBM3 jax 0.6.0: template pair transition c 64 x2 (431 / 500 / 800 tokens, NxN lead) d/dx cosine 0.579 / 0.580 / 0.580 vs an f32 reference, norm ratio 1.115, d/dW1 0.57, d/dW2 0.23-0.31, d/d(LN scale) 0.28-0.51; pair transition c 128 x4 (431 / 800) d/dx 0.584 / 0.621, norm 1.14 / 1.23, d/dW2 -0.08 / 0.07; A100-SXM4-80GB jax 0.6.0: c 64 x2 d/dx 0.580, norm 1.115, d/dW2 0.00-0.33. The statement and cd_transition read d/dx 0.9995 / norm 1.000 / d/dW 0.9994-1.0000 in the same runs; f32 (its precision words) reads 0.9999 everywhere; the jax 0.5 line reads 0.9995 (H100) / 0.9999 (A100) for the same setting in bf16. Its forward is correct (relrms 2.9e-3 = the fused row's). Refused by name for (bf16, differentiated, jax 0.6) with kind wrong_gradient; no tier cell named it as a bf16 fwd+bwd candidate, so no cell moves.
refusal_evidence.cd_transition_dtype: the carried design-loop transition row's operand contract: bf16 activations with bf16 weights / biases (bf16 x bf16 tile products, f32 accumulation; LayerNorm f32). A bf16 x f32 tile product does not lower (Pallas dot_general lowering error on every measured stack), so the face hands weights / biases to the tiles in the activation dtype and refuses non-bf16 activations by name (kind dtype_not_served; f32 callers: mlp_transition's precision words or the statement). Through the face at that contract its gradients are the statement's own bf16 class on cc 9.0 and 8.0, jax 0.6 and 0.5 (d/dx cosine 0.9995, norm 1.000, d/dW1 0.9994-0.9995, d/dW2 1.0000, d/d(LN scale) 0.9993-0.9995 at c 64 x2 431 / 500 / 800 tokens and c 128 x4 431 / 800).

program_floors.doc: size floors an adopting program measured in its OWN step (end to end, not op-level) and this table applies under tier words: a cell carrying 'n_floor' = {below, arm, source} serves `arm` (the stock statement) for calls with fewer tokens than `below`; row words are unaffected (default rule)

trimul_f32_design_320.source: the design program's former constant MIN_KERNEL_PIXELS = 320^2 (below it the fused Pallas triangle multiplication lost to its XLA statement inside its differentiated f32 step); consistent with this table's fwd+bwd cells at N<=200 on both cards (the stock statement is the fastest arm there) and with cc 8.0 fwd+bwd at every size; the forward-only cc 9.0 cell at N<=200 measures cd_trimul x1.37 op-level -- a forward-only caller below 320 tokens reaches it by the row word

attn_bf16_af2_subbatch128_512.source: an adopting AlphaFold-2-form structure-prediction program (alphafold-colabfold 2.3 modules, bf16, forward only) calls these families per sub-batch CHUNK of 128 pair rows (B=128, S = tokens), not per full triangle (B = S) as this table's tri_* / tmpl_* cells were timed; at that shape on cc 9.0 (H100 80GB HBM3, jax 0.5.3) its same-process per-call pairs of the bridge's cuda_sm90a row against pallas_attn (default launch) read, D32 h4 triangle attention: S 400 +33.5 %, S 448 +43.9 % (bridge slower), S 512 -2.3 %, S 576 -8.4 %, S 800 -22 %, S 1200 -34 % (bridge faster); D32 h8 MSA row attention: -21.5 % from S 512, -33.5 % / -41.9 % at S 800 / 1200; D16 h4 (the template pair stack, k2b_aot): S 400 +42.8 %, S 800 -7.6 %, S 1200 -9.5 %; end to end with the bridge from 512 keys: -12.3 % per predict at 800 tokens, peak unchanged (2.801 -> 2.802 GiB) -- 512 keys was its kit-side floor, deleted when it bound the tier word (colabfold_opt CHANGES.md 0.2.10 / 0.2.13, the TRIATTN_XLA lever's pairs). cc 8.0 carries no floor: there the bridge (k2b_aot then) from 400 keys measured -9.8 % per predict at 400 tokens end to end (A100-SXM4-80GB, same program), and cuda_80 heads its order now. The arm below the floor is pallas_attn (the tier word applies its measured launch setting, pallas_attn@s3 on 9.0): what that program ran below 512 keys. A B = S caller on the 0.5 line below 512 tokens reaches the bridge by the row word (default rule); this table's B = S cells there (N<=256: bridge x1.2 over the fused Pallas core) are op-level at B = S.

transition_af2_bf16_inmodel.source: the AlphaFold2-multimer batch inference program on the 0.5 line (jax 0.5.3, bf16 Evoformer, sub-batched transitions) measured the fused row composed at EVERY transition site of its compiled forward pass (Evoformer msa / pair, extra-MSA, template pair stack; mlp_transition by row word) against the stock statement, same device, interleaved arms, 3 recycles, forward seconds per pass: A100-SXM4-80GB +3.4 / +6.5 / +8.3 % at 400 / 800 / 1200 tokens (slower), peak +229 MiB at 800; H100 0.0 / +0.9 / +1.9 % at 400 / 800 / 1200 (slower), peak +162 MiB at 800 and +256 MiB at 1200 (one more pair-sized buffer: the custom call's un-aliased output). Op-level, this table's cells measure the fused rows at x1.02-1.81 of the unfused statement; inside the compiled Evoformer XLA fuses the stock transition's LayerNorm / bias / ReLU / residual around two GEMMs per sub-batch chunk and the custom call is a fusion barrier, so the composed program loses end to end on both parts. Under tier words the stock statement serves at every size on the 0.5 line (below_tokens spans every bucket); row words are unaffected (default rule); an in-model re-race by the table's owner decides any change.; the extra-MSA transition family (c 64, factor 4; 1024 extra-MSA rows x tokens) is one of the sites that program composed, so its cells carry the same floor

big_rule: big = the first arm of fast's order (the bridge arm included where it heads fast) that carries NO measured memory cost: an arm whose peak_mib (XLA memory analysis of the jitted arm) exceeds the stock statement's by more than max(8 MiB, 2 %) is passed over (named); per-call deltas below that are not a cost. This replaces 'the lowest-peak arm at >= x1.00' (which sent triangle attention to a slower library op at a few MiB per call although an adopting program measured the fused rows at 0.00 GiB program peak cost and -18 / -43 s per program at 2048 / 3072 tokens). Each measured cell's 'big' field is that arm; 'big_lowest_peak' keeps the former value where it differed.
program_evidence_rule: a cell may carry 'program_evidence' {arm: text} with 'tier_excluded' [arms]: arms an adopting program measured slower INSIDE its program than the row the tier word would otherwise pass over, on that card and form; such arms are dropped from fast_order (tier words) and keep serving by row word; the op-level numbers stay in 'ms' / 'x_stock' unchanged
library_rows: rows tokamax / tokamax_glu / tokamax_glu_T and the arms tokamax@<impl> are the tokamax library's ops: measured on the stacks named in 'stacks' that carry the library (the jax 0.10 line's reference images); on an image of the same line WITHOUT the library the arm is statically refused BY NAME (not importable) and the tier word serves the next arm of the cell's order -- the cell stays as measured (no per-image re-wording); a program that wants the library arm installs the library (jax >= 0.7 lines only); the adoption notes list, per cell where a tokamax arm heads a tier, the next arm and its x_stock
unmeasured_cc_rule: decided PER KEY (line, dtype, op, family, direction), never per compute capability: the caller's own column is consulted first; when it holds no MEASURED cell for that key -- whether or not it holds cells for other keys -- the nearest arch-compatible measured column that does serves the tier words: parts with major >= 9 (9.x, 10.0 / 10.3, 12.x) <- columns with major >= 9 at or below the part, nearest first (10.3 -> 10.0 -> 9.0); 8.x <- 8.x columns at or below it (8.9 -> 8.6 -> 8.0); older parts: the statement by name. Inherited are the source-compiled Pallas / Triton rows and the XLA statements of that column's cell, in its order (the big rule applies); NOT inherited: the prebuilt per-arch bridge rows (native_xla = the sm_90a triangle-multiplication kernels, triattn_xla / proj+triattn_xla = the triangle-attention bridge's per-arch rows) and cudnn arms while a Triton row remains; tokamax arms only where the library imports (static refusal by name otherwise). exact on such a key = the stock statement (exact is vouched per stack). The decision carries the census token inherited_cc:unmeasured(from <column>) (+ partial_cc when the caller's cc holds cells for other keys); a Pallas tile that fails to launch on the new part is refused by name at call time and the serving walk takes the next arm (never a silent statement while an arch-portable row remains).
